responsibility: Implements GCC’s standard RTL dataflow problem instances on top of the generic df framework. It defines the local-transfer, confluence, initialization, reset, allocation, free, and dump logic for canonical analyses such as reaching definitions, live/register reachability variants, chains, and multi-definition tracking, including problem-specific bitmap layouts, sparse-vs-dense kill handling, EH-edge effects, and the df_problem descriptors that register these analyses with the solver.
